title: Stand upright
metaphor: Exactly ONE solid ochre wooden crate standing perfectly upright and flat on one short dark floor line. A thick dark slate carpenters right-angle square hugs its lower-right corner, with one horizontal foot and one vertical arm clearly marking a ninety-degree upright alignment. ONE broad dark slate curved arrow rises outside the LEFT side of the crate and ends pointing straight UP, signifying straighten and reset tilt. The arrow must NOT enter or point into the crate. Only ONE crate silhouette in the entire image. No second crate, no ghost crate, no motion-trail object, no open box, no container cavity, no packing or storage gesture.
